📺 Pattern Hunger. A sequence of foods. Eat them in the right order. The wrong order... disagrees with you.

The audience expects entertainment, not blood.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

The wrong order... disagrees with you. The audience knows the order. They are not telling.

📺 The Guest. An alien ambassador is coming to dinner at your haven. Televised. Serve something it finds interesting, and survive an etiquette you were never taught.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A ship the size of weather settles over the haven. Out steps the ambassador: too many limbs, impeccable manners, and a retinue of cameras.

It is coming to DINNER. At your table. Tonight.

Nobody knows what it eats. The veterans who've hosted before just smile tightly and say "you'll see."
